title: Write and stress-test an optimization contract
mission: Choose a loss and update policy for the Phase 1 prediction problem and demonstrate useful and failed training behavior.

starting_state.known_good_state: The supported rate follows the displayed loss toward its minimum.

guided.objective: Trace loss, gradient, and one supported update.
guided.expected_observation: The update moves opposite the gradient and reduces the displayed loss.

steps: Select a loss from error cost
challenge.expected_observation: Different rates create distinguishable convergence and failure patterns.

engineer_extension.objective: Compare optimizer state and convergence under a fixed budget.
steps: Run gradient descent and an adaptive optimizer
engineer_extension.expected_observation: Optimizer choice changes trajectory and checkpoint state without replacing evaluation evidence.

failure_experiment.failure_signal: Loss and parameter magnitude increase across updates.
failure_experiment.recovery: Reduce the rate, reset state, and rerun from the same initialization.

acceptance_criteria: Loss choice is justified from operational error cost.
Stable and unstable runs are reproducible.
Optimization telemetry is distinct from release evaluation.
recovery: Reset optimizer state before comparing rates.
Use the same starting weight and step budget across runs.
